programme.desc: Timmy Wants the Blues. Timmy is having a blue day and collects all the blue toys, blue cushions and blue paint.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Rainbows and Nursery Rhymes. It's a rainy morning, and as the children arrive, there is a rainbow over the school.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Pickle Power Girl. Jen and Small are playing superheroes and are ready to save the world.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Aye-Aye and Prevost's Squirrel. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal a surprising connection between them. This time, it's the aye-aye and the Prevost's squirrel.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Astronomer. Astronomer Carole tells us how her amazing astronomy binoculars help her to see stars and planets in the night sky.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Homework. Hearing dog Diesel visits the library to help his owner, Rayane, with his homework.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Refrigerator and Mushrooms. Maddie stays at home and shows us how a fridge works and visits a farm where mushrooms are grown all year round.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Bag. Dee encourages a friend to say 'bag', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see lots of bags - a big bag, a tiny bag, a shiny bag and even a beeping bag!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: How to Count. Children's animation. It is a lovely day for a picnic, but a flapjack is missing! Is there a snaffler on the loose or has Three forgotten what Numberblocks do best?

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Zap. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. Z likes a good snooze, filling the air with floaty zeds.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Rainy Day Bears. Go and Stop are visiting the Three Bears for some puddle splashing. The bears are excited to play in the rain, but they all have very different ideas about how to get ready.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Yellow. Yellow is happy to bring his colour to Colourland. Learn about the colour yellow.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Topiary Badge. After seeing Duggee's topiary skills, the Squirrels are keen to try it out for themselves.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: All Change. Yukee is struggling with a tune on her ukulele, so she tells her friends she's going to give it up.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Dinosaurs. Justin and his friends go to a dinosaur park, while Mr Tumble visits Shopkeeper Tumble.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Conga. Preschool series. The Teletubbies do conga dances over the hills, then they conga into Home Dome to answer the Tubby Phone and do a special conga Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Woolly Rhino and Flowers. Adventure series. Andy goes in search of a woolly rhino, travelling back 50,000 years to a snowy, prehistoric mountain range.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle's Wonderful Art. Preschool comedy drama series. Waffle discovers he has a talent for painting Mrs Hobbs's cat, George, and decides it could be a way to get in her good books.

programme.title: Topsy and Tim
programme.desc: Helping Dad. Live-action children's show. Topsy and Tim wallpaper their parents' bedroom with Dad, but he isn't very good at decorating and they get in a terrible mess.

programme.title: What's on Your Head?
programme.desc: Turban. Rajvatan, who is a Sikh, tells us all about his terrific turban and what it means to him to wear it.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Raa Raa's Noisy Present. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa makes Topsy a wonderful present - a noisy set of chimes.

programme.title: New: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: What a Troublesome Beaverling. The Game Catchers land on a forested planet to play impish ball.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Pininga Turtle. While testing out the new Terra-Gup 6, Tweak crash lands in the desert.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Hot and Cold. Volcanic smoke blocks the three Proximan suns, which causes Big Lizard to become worryingly cold. Cosima's on the case and comes up with a superhot solution!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Broccoli Flies Again. Broccoli learns to fly, but her paper plane takes her right into Evil Pea's freezer.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Jam Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee is making jam, but Naughty Monkey steals all of Duggee's fruit. Can the Squirrels help catch him?

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Spilled Milk. Animated series. When Peter, Lily and Benjamin accidentally spill Mittens's milk, they launch a daring mission to replace it.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: School Rules. The children create a list of class rules to follow to all get along at school. They then put them into practice by sharing together, being kind to each other and tidying.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo Drop the Ball. Mojo and Bo's wrecking ball might destroy a lot more than it's supposed to!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Show and Tell. Bluey wants to know why Dad is always bossing her around!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Sticky Gecko. The kids are late for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Mystery Gossiper. A mystery gossiper causes friction on the berg, until Brinicle sets a clever trap.

programme.title: New: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: In or Out. Dodge has the final say on whether the class have Golden Hour inside or outside, but he struggles with the decision.

programme.title: New: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: Waffle's Birthday Surprise. Waffle's birthday surprise: puppuccino mishaps, birthday sing along and lots of tail wags.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: The Longest Day. Summer is here! Hooray! But, where's Mossy?

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: It's Time to Meet a New Baby. JoJo and Gran Gran spend the day with Navid and his new baby, Akeel. JoJo realises she was once a baby too!

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Pepi Nana's Favourite List. Pepi Nana makes a list of her favourite things before doing them all in Storyland.

programme.desc: The Space Tortoise. Animation about a family of small creatures who live on, and inside, a planet. A space tortoise is woken up by a mysterious tune Tiny heard coming from the sky.

programme.title: The First of the Few
programme.desc: 1942. War. Directed by and stars Leslie Howard. Features David Niven & Rosamund John. Aviation pioneer R.J. Mitchell struggles to develop the Spitfire fighter plane before war with Germany begins.

programme.title: The Day Of The Triffids
programme.desc: 1962. Sci-Fi. A spectacular meteor storm blinds the world, except Bill. He, and a few others, must battle with flesh eating plants. Stars Nicole Maurey, Howard Keel, Janette Scott & Kieron Moore.

programme.title: Richard's Things
programme.desc: 1980. Starring Liv Ullman and Amanda Redman. Richard dies of a heart attack whilst away on business, when collecting his things his wife learns that he had been travelling with another woman.

programme.title: Life In Emergency Ward 10
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Based on the smash hit TV series about the daily life and the ups and downs of a hospital. Stars Michael Craig, Wilfred Hyde-White and Joan Sims.

programme.title: Look At Life For the Record
programme.desc: 1961. A behind the scenes look at the record industry, featuring Helen Shapiro, with glimpses of the finished disc and how they are produced.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: Ben Thompson Returns. 1955. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Denver Pyle, Yvette Duguay. Wyatt's use of sanitation laws to shut down saloons with crooked games angers the saloon owners, who send men after him.

programme.title: Look At Life Women in Green
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the incredible Women's Voluntary Service. The women in green remain reliable and will always be first on the scene when disaster strikes in Britain.

programme.title: Double Confession
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Starring Derek Farr, Joan Hopkins & Peter Lorre. Farr visits his ex-wife only to find her murdered. In his attempts to find the killer he meets gang boss William Hartnell.

programme.title: The Punching Preacher
programme.desc: An insightful documentary by Peter Williams about George Foreman, a man of great faith who was known as one of the best fighters who ever lived, who twice held the World Heavyweight title.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: A River for All Seasons and Bass Fishing. 1980. Countryman Jack Hargreaves takes to the river for a spot of dry fly fishing for brown trout, before going to sea in search of bass.

programme.title: Dead Man's Evidence
programme.desc: 1963. Crime drama directed by Francis Searle and starring Conrad Phillips and Jane Griffiths. Phillips stars as a British secret agent investigating the discovery of a dead, washed up frogman.

programme.title: Film Magic - Switch Off and Go Together (Energy Saving)
programme.desc: 1942. Using the magic of camera work, this video portrays the importance of saving fuel and how to do so.

programme.title: First Man Into Space
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Robert Day. Stars Marshall Thompson & Marla Landi. A U.S. Navy test pilot rockets himself into space but vanishes. Soon after, a blood thirsty creature appears on Earth.

programme.title: Dixon of Dock Green
programme.desc: The Rotten Apple. 1956. Stars Jack Warner, Stanley Beard & Paul Eddington. A fresh spate of robberies lead the police to pursue a criminal known as The Captain. But is he the man behind it all?

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1953. The Drayton Case. Directed by Ken Hughes. Stars Victor Platt & Vincent Ball. The aftermath of a wartime air raid reveals the body of a murdered woman. (S1, E01)

programme.title: Top of the Bill
programme.desc: 1971. Lost Documentary feature about the great days of variety with Ben Warriss, Davey Kaye, Sally Barnes, Peter Cavanagh, Ken Goodwin & more.

programme.title: The Atomic Submarine
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet. Stars Arthur Franz & Dick Foran. A submarine is sent out to investigate a series of naval disasters, but the crew also get caught up in the chaos.

programme.title: London To Brighton Car Run
programme.desc: A fascinating short film from the London to Brighton car run, featuring some wonderful vintage cars.

programme.title: The Angel Who Pawned Her Harp
programme.desc: 1954. Drama starring Felix Aylmer, Diane Cilento and Jerry Desmond. A beautiful angel is sent to The Angel, London, to help people with problems, but she has no money to support herself.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: We Shall See. 1964. Directed by Quentin Lawrence. Stars Maurice Kaufmann, Faith Brook & Alec Mango. Alva Collins, attractive wife of a captain in a civil airline, struggles.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by George Jenkins. Stars Charles Boyer, Andrea King & Allen Jenkins. After a pickpocket steals an attractive woman's purse, he discovers her son is dying and decides to help.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Come Back, Shame. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Cliff Robertson. Batman and Robin reckon something's up when Shame steals Grimaldi Smith's hot racing car in the middle of the Gotham City 500.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Down to the Sea. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, John Paul & Gordon Jackson. After Maguire finds a detective stabbed at Tilbury Docks, he finds the case has repercussions on an international level.

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
programme.desc: 1969. The Stealer of Marble. Stars: Hugh Burden, Willoughby Goddard & Mona Bruce. The case of the disappearance of Billingham, Director of Telfers Trust, who has absconded with £150,000.

programme.title: Blind Corner
programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars William Sylvester, Barbara Shelley & Elizabeth Shepherd. The wife of a blind composer plots to murder her husband after he learns of her affair.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is back with an intriguing combination of films tonight. The rats are back in our first offering, the 1972 horror Ben - the vicious sequel to Willard, starring Lee Montgomery.

programme.title: Ben
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars Lee Montgomery, Joseph Campanella & Arthur O'Connell. A lonely boy befriends Ben, a rat who is the leader of a violent rodent army.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline presents the second film of the evening, 1980's The Ninth Configuration. This psychological drama was written, produced and directed by the writer of The Exorcist - William Peter Blatty.

programme.title: The Ninth Configuration
programme.desc: 1980. Drama. Directed by William Peter Blatty. Stars Stacy Keach, Scott Wilson & Jason Miller. A military psychiatrist arrives at a remote asylum and attempts to rehabilitate the patients within.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: After a spectacular evening of unique films full of darkness, terror and a little fun, Caroline Munro closes the doors of The Cellar Club once more.

programme.title: Resurrection of Zachary Wheeler
programme.desc: 1971. Sci-Fi starring Leslie Nielsen, Bradford Dillman and Don Haggerty. After a terrible car accident, a presidential candidate awakens in a New Mexico clinic without a trace of injury.

programme.title: Aberdeen: The Silver City
programme.desc: A late 50s local authority travelogue showcasing the wonders of the great Scottish city of Aberdeen.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted. 1963. Stars Irene Ryan & Herbert Rudley. Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but now the doctor wants to see Granny.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
